large_corpus.intended_role: Large-corpus generic reaction pretraining; retain USPTO-50K as the class-labeled controlled benchmark.

uspto_pretraining.coverage_method: A candidate formation has the product motif and no reactant molecule with that motif. Heterocycle formation uses USPTO class 4. Motif counts are screening-level upper bounds, not route validation.
